name: Nogami Yomi
source:
She was born with a keen sensitivity and possessed the ability to sense electromagnetic waves from a young age.
Although she has no physical strength whatsoever, she possesses a demonic power that allows her to read her opponents’ minds and control their minds and bodies by sending heavy waves into them.
